description: Plain-message payload boundary coverage: an empty message text is still emitted as a present (empty) field, a UTF-8 message carrying non-ASCII characters and an embedded '=' is preserved byte-for-byte, and a long single-line message is forwarded intact. The identifier length and fresh-session last_event_id remain stable across message shapes.

cases.expected_output:
url=http://h.test/api/9999999999/store/
platform=c
message=città 日本語 ✓ a=b
event_id_length=32
last_event_id=0

event.message: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 0123456789 - and keeps going on and on to exercise a long single-line message payload without any newline characters at all.

cases.expected_output:
url=https://sentry.io/api/123/store/
platform=c
message=The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 0123456789 - and keeps going on and on to exercise a long single-line message payload without any newline characters at all.
event_id_length=32
